name: Precision Cable Assemblies Inc. (PCA)

about:
Precision Cable Assemblies Inc. (PCA) was founded in 1980 in Brookfield, Wisconsin, a suburb of Milwaukee. The company began as a wire harness manufacturer and has since expanded into a global supplier of power distribution solutions.

PCA manufactures wire harnesses ranging from single-circuit assemblies to complex designs with over 300 circuits, battery cables and interconnects, and custom overmolded cable assemblies. Its capabilities include design and development, rapid prototyping, program management with PPAP support, CAD modeling, and in-house injection molding for over-molding and connector production. The company operates manufacturing facilities in Brookfield, Wisconsin; Qingdao, China; and Monterrey, Mexico, with a warehousing and distribution center in Waukesha, Wisconsin, all linked by a single SAP ERP system.

The company serves original equipment manufacturers across construction equipment, agricultural machinery, power generation, lawn and garden, marine, recreational and utility vehicles, trailer chassis, over-the-road trucks, emergency vehicles, and small-engine applications. Notable projects include heavy-duty harnesses for semi-trailers, marine battery cables, UTV engine compartment solutions, and a large off-highway program for Husco.

PCA emphasizes a lean, vertically integrated model with continuous process improvement (5S, Kaizen, DMAIC) and round-the-clock engineering collaboration across its three plants. It offers vendor-managed inventory, Kanban, and EDI logistics programs, and aims to deliver on-time, quality products with accurate communication.
